 4 more die of dengue
 Published : 12 November 2026
 • 
 Updated : 12 November 2026, 05:26
 • 
 BANGLADESH
 SHARE 
 Staff Correspondent 
 At least four dengue patients died, and 1,900 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours till 8:00am yesterday, according to the Directorate General of Health Services.
 All four deaths were reported from the Dhaka division.
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the latest fatalities, the death toll from dengue this year has risen to 478, while the cumulative number of cases has reached 1,55,668. 
 Currently, 6,067 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at hospitals across the country.
